presets.name: Chord into pad
presets.desc: Stomp on, strum one chord, stomp off: the chord plays eight times slower as a seamless looped pad
presets.notes: The intro pad: the pre-roll seam makes the loop invisible; the 100 Hz cut keeps the pad off the bass

presets.name: Drone under a verse
presets.desc: One low note captured and stretched sixty times into a level, widened drone under the verse
presets.notes: Compress 60 % holds the drone level through the note's decay; spread 120 cents widens each partial

presets.name: Infinite hold
presets.desc: Capture a chord, then Freeze holds one instant of it forever while you play over it
presets.notes: The hold-machine gesture: Freeze on the footswitch; a 4 s crossfade lets the next take arrive slowly

presets.name: Voice into the outro
presets.desc: The last sung line captured and stretched twenty times: the vowels hang over the outro
presets.notes: A 341 ms window keeps the vowels readable; the tone at 9 kHz tames the stretched sibilants

presets.name: Ambient shadow
presets.desc: Hands-free: a slow ghost of what you just played, six times slower, refreshed every twelve seconds
presets.notes: Rolling needs no footswitch: each resync takes a new snapshot of the playing and crossfades to it

presets.name: Live spectral smear
presets.desc: The present, smeared through random phases: a diffuse halo a fifth of a second behind the playing
presets.notes: At ×1 Rolling reads the present: the wet is the input with fresh phases, late by window + hop (213 ms)

presets.name: Slow-motion keys
presets.desc: An arpeggio captured and played two and a half times slower with its notes still clear
presets.notes: Cloud 15 % is the coherent end: peak-locked phases keep the notes, a little randomness hides the phasiness

presets.name: Glass octave drone
presets.desc: A captured chord stretched forty times and lifted an octave into a thin, glassy drone
presets.notes: The pitch remap keeps the power; 40 cents of spread softens the octave's partials

presets.name: Sub bed
presets.desc: A bass note captured, stretched thirty times and dropped an octave: a mono sub bed under the band
presets.notes: Width 0 keeps the low end mono; the tone at 1.5 kHz leaves only the sub

presets.name: Bells from a chord
presets.desc: A captured chord shifted up 70 Hz: inharmonic, bell-like partials stretched twelve times
presets.notes: A frequency shift moves every partial by the same Hz: the harmonic series becomes bells

presets.name: Noise-band wash
presets.desc: Stretched a hundred times and spread over an octave: the playing becomes bands of level, steady noise
presets.notes: The constant-Q blur keeps the energy while it widens; compress 80 % flattens the level swings

presets.name: Tight grain
presets.desc: A riff captured and stretched three times through a 21 ms window: a rhythmic, grainy flutter
presets.notes: Short windows keep the riff's rhythm and add a flutter: the low end of PaulXStretch's grain

presets.name: Scene swell
presets.desc: A take captured beforehand fades back in over six seconds when the pedal is engaged at the chorus
presets.notes: The take survives bypass: engage the block with its scene and the pad swells back from the take's start

presets.name: Glacier
presets.desc: Five hundred times slower, spread and compressed: a note becomes a still, minutes-long glacier
presets.notes: Above ×100: golem's catalogue knob stops at 100, so this preset needs its maximum raised (README §3.1)

presets.name: Ghost voice
presets.desc: Hands-free on a vocal lane: a dark, quiet ghost of the last phrase, three times slower
presets.notes: Rolling on a voice: the ghost follows the song in snapshots; the 5 kHz tone keeps it behind the singer
